thesis: The episode argues that the age of AI will fundamentally reshape commerce by favoring trusted aggregators and retailers with strong attribution capabilities over single-sku specialists. It posits that companies like Costco and Amazon are positioned differently: Costco is viewed as an 'AI-proof' fortress due to its refusal to compromise on quality and its membership-based trust model, whereas Amazon is seen as a winner in the aggregator space but criticized for having no incentive to clean up its marketplace of low-quality goods and bogus reviews.
